title: Rehearsal Rooms Required
description:
## Task

A theatre has booked a set of rehearsal slots. Each slot occupies a room from its start time up to, but not including, its end time, so a slot that ends at time 10 and one that starts at time 10 can share a room. Find the fewest rooms that can host every slot. Sort the starts and the ends separately and sweep through time.

## Input

- `slots` — a list of `[start, end]` pairs with `start < end`. It may be empty.

## Output

The minimum number of rooms needed; `0` for no slots.

## Example

```python
rehearsal_rooms([[0, 30], [5, 10], [15, 20]])  # returns 2
rehearsal_rooms([[1, 4], [4, 6], [6, 9]])  # returns 1
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `slots` ≤ 10^5
- 0 ≤ `start` < `end` ≤ 10^9
